recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-5221 unless FHIR-I wants to revisit the broader example wording independently of this resolved grammatical clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-5221 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I DSTU1 clarification from Jan 2015 Ballot Comment #98 asking the Resource References page to say a Condition references a Procedure as its cause, rather than saying it links to the Procedure, so the example consistently made the Condition the subject of both clauses.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN revision 4513, represented in git as baca552c90cca270c782e94757dc477734614e63, which changed source/references.html from 'it links to' to 'references' in the non-transitive-reference example.
additional_context: The current source/references.html page is in build scope through the active source/fhir.ini type-page mapping for Reference to references. Later edits rewrote the example to use Procedure.subject and Procedure.reason, FHIR-19931 corrected the rewritten example's mistaken second Procedure link to Condition, and FHIR-33008 later adjusted nearby contained-resource guidance without restoring the old ambiguous wording.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current references page already avoids the old wording ambiguity and preserves the intended rule that relationships are not transitive; reverting to or duplicating the original 2015 sentence would conflict with later accepted cleanups.
